prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Generate ONE English Patterns learning atlas.
Pattern context: I + فعل بالمضارع البسيط + every day. Style: Photorealistic everyday editorial photography, warm natural light, coherent with the existing learning atlases.
Canvas width:height MUST be THREE:FOUR (0.75), not 1:2. Exactly 3 columns by 4 rows of SQUARE photographic cells, with narrow continuous pure white divider gutters. All twelve cells visible. Final display contract 1536x2048.
Conservative Arab Muslim family learning contexts. Men wear loose opaque long-sleeved high-neck shirts and full-length trousers or thobes. Women wear loose opaque full-coverage clothing and hijab. Apply modest clothing to background people too.
No bare torso, shoulders, midriff or thighs, tight or transparent clothes, revealing nightwear, swimwear, underwear, changing, bathing, showering, intimate or romantic poses, kissing or inappropriate physical contact.
Water and beach contexts use fully clothed people on a dry shore, promenade or empty poolside. Never show swimmers, sunbathers, mixed bathing or distant revealing figures. Depict swimming discussions before the activity, with equipment where useful.
No alcohol, gambling, nightclub setting, graphic injury, active weapon violence, or religious caricatures. Use ordinary respectful Arab settings without adding religious rituals unrelated to the sentence.
Preserve the exact English sentence and Arabic meaning. Adapt only the visual staging. If a compliant scene cannot convey the meaning honestly, hold the cell for review instead of substituting an unrelated picture.
No captions, words, numbers, logos, speech/thought bubbles, graphic overlays or floating inset pictures. Physical analog clocks can use hands and tick marks for time examples.
Exactly three columns and four rows in row-major order, twelve square cells, portrait 3:4, final atlas 1536x2048, 512x512 per cell with 40px safe inset and continuous straight white dividers. Measure actual source gutters before preparing the display atlas.
The following English sentences are context only: do not render their text. Exact panel order, left to right then top to bottom:
1. Meaning: I practice English every day. Visual staging: An adult carrying out a regular daily activity. Specific context: I practice English every day. No captions or written speech.
2. Meaning: I drink water every day. Visual staging: An adult carrying out a regular daily activity. Specific context: I drink water every day. No captions or written speech.
3. Meaning: I walk for twenty minutes every day. Visual staging: An adult carrying out a regular daily activity. Specific context: I walk for twenty minutes every day. No captions or written speech.
4. Meaning: I write three sentences every day. Visual staging: An adult carrying out a regular daily activity. Specific context: I write three sentences every day. No captions or written speech.
5. Meaning: I check my calendar every day. Visual staging: An adult checking a desk calendar at the start of the day.
6. Meaning: I feed the cat every day. Visual staging: An adult filling a cat bowl in a kitchen.
7. Meaning: I learn something useful every day. Visual staging: An adult learning a practical task from a colleague.
8. Meaning: I take the bus to work every day. Visual staging: An adult commuter boarding a city bus.
9. Meaning: I call my parents every day. Visual staging: An adult talking warmly to parents on a video call.
10. Meaning: I spend ten minutes reviewing new words every day. Visual staging: An adult reviewing vocabulary cards beside a small timer.
11. Meaning: I tidy my desk every day before I leave. Visual staging: An adult putting office supplies away at the end of work.
12. Meaning: I make a little progress every day, even when I am busy. Visual staging: An adult completing a short study activity during a work break.


Input image is ONLY a layout and photographic-style reference. Make a completely NEW atlas replacing EVERY breakfast scene with the following regular daily activities. Preserve its overall 3:4 shape and exactly equal three columns/four rows of SQUARE cells. No duplicate panels, no merged panels. Important people and props safely inside each cell. Concrete staging: 1 a modest adult woman in opaque hijab practising spoken English with headphones and a notebook at a study desk; 2 a fully clothed man drinking a clear glass of water; 3 a fully covered adult man walking on a park path with a small wristwatch (no visible numbers); 4 a hijab-wearing woman writing three short illegible lines in a notebook, no legible words; 5 fully clothed man checking a physical desk calendar with a blank unlabeled grid; 6 modest woman filling a bowl for a cat on the kitchen floor; 7 a fully covered male colleague showing another man how to use a small hand tool at a safe workbench; 8 fully covered commuter boarding a real city bus for work; 9 modest woman having a video call on a real laptop screen showing her modest elderly parents, no floating inset portrait; 10 fully covered male learner reviews small vocabulary cards with blank/illegible faces beside an unlabelled timer; 11 modest woman putting pens and papers into an organized desk drawer; 12 fully clothed man taking a short study break at a work desk with notebook, closed work laptop and mug. Natural Arab everyday contexts. All foreground/background people in loose opaque high-neck long sleeves and full-length garments; all adult women in opaque hijab. No readable text, labels, letters or numbers. Daily frequency is conveyed by the teaching sentence, do not add calendar icons or repetition overlays. Output whole image aspect ratio exactly THREE:FOUR, not a tall1:2 image.
